metadata.title: BiteMap — fishing closer to nature
metadata.description: A map and community for anglers: discover fishing spots, plan trips, and share photos and reports.

home.title: Find your
home.lead: BiteMap is a map and community for anglers: discover fishing spots, plan trips and share your own experience.
home.start: Everything for a trip in one place
home.howItWorksTitle: From discovery to your own fishing story.
home.howItWorksLead: BiteMap brings together a map, practical fishing-spot information and community experience, so it is easier to choose a place and share trusted finds.
home.stepExploreText: Search fishing spots by name, oblast, settlement, water body type or fish species.
home.stepPlanText: Check access, fish, photos and coordinates, then build a route in your navigation app.
home.stepShareText: Add your own fishing spots, photos and reports about catches, conditions and impressions to help other anglers.
home.whatYouGetCommunity: photos, saved places and community reports

articles.pageDescription: Practical articles about choosing a fishing spot, feeder fishing and planning a trip.
articles.title: Make your next trip count.
articles.lead: Practical guides to fishing spots, tackle and technique — clear, useful advice to take with you to the water.

articleAdmin.title: Manage articles
articleAdmin.lead: Write in Ukrainian and English, save drafts and publish finished fishing guides.
articleAdmin.signInTitle: Log in to the editorial area
articleAdmin.signInText: Only BiteMap administrators can manage articles.
articleAdmin.accessText: To enable this account, create a Firestore document admins/{uid}, where uid is your user ID shown below. Only the project owner can create this document in Firebase Console.

articleAdmin.editorLead: Ukrainian content is required. Leave English fields empty to use the Ukrainian version on the site.

editor.slugHint: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, e.g. feeder-basics. It cannot be changed after creation.
